title: 8/5/26: Moderate Weather Alert Issued; Clear Skies and 82.8, High of 86.2, Low of 70.2, Wind 4 mph - NewsBreak
text:
By Source Staff ,
5 hours ago Special Weather Statement
Source: NWS
A Moderate Special Weather Statement is currently in effect for Maury County.
As of 6:00 PM, the temperature is 82.8°F with a light wind from the southeast at 4 mph. There has been no recorded precipitation today, and the sky is currently clear.
Earlier today, the high reached 86.2°F, while the low was 70.2°F. Heading into tonight, temperatures are expected to drop to a low of 74.7°F. The wind will remain light, with speeds up to 4.5 mph, and the chance of precipitation is low at 11%.
The Moderate Special Weather Statement advises residents to remain aware of potential weather changes in the area. Further updates will be provided as necessary.
